description: The file defines a React functional component 'PostCard' used to display a social media post, including user info, content, and interaction buttons such as like and comment. It manages optimistic UI updates for likes and interacts with a backend via supabase RPC.

methods.name: PostCard({ post, onOpen })
methods.description: React functional component rendering a social media post card with user info, content, and actions.

methods.name: like
methods.description: Asynchronous function triggered on like button click, updates UI optimistically, calls backend RPC to register the like, and reverts UI if error occurs.
